_comment: Notable SpaceX launches only. Routine Starlink and rideshare missions
are excluded on purpose: SpaceX flew 42 times in the 104 days after
SPCX listed, and a calendar that lists all of them buries the share
unlocks. What qualifies: Starship flights, crewed missions, Falcon
status is the source's own word and is never upgraded here.
TBD = no date; stored with date null so it is never drawn as one.
The schedule prints placeholders like 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z to mean
'sometime in 2026'. Those are recorded as null, not as 31 December.
time_et is Eastern, to match the trading day. Launch times slip more
than almost any scheduled time in industry.
Nothing in this file claims a launch moves the price.

SPCX.source: Launch Library 2 (ll.thespacedevs.com), read 24 Sep 2026. spacex.com/launches renders in JavaScript and cannot be read directly.

events.note: Flown. The only Starship flight in SPCX's trading history.
